newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: C.BANK REGISTERS SIAULIU SHARE CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK REGISTERS SIAULIU SHARE CAPITAL.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Friday that its board decided to register the new share capital of regional Siauliu Bank.
The central bank said in a statement that it has registered Siauliu Bank's statute changes related to a share capital boost to 34.021 million litas from 20 million litas.
Siauliu Bank issued 280,000 new ordinary shares with a face value of 50 litas per share.
The bank said earlier that 6.8 million litas of the new shares were bought by current shareholders and the rest of the issue was sold to the Baltic fund.
